lb-16m8.title: Fix structured_output parsing in shipper readiness check
lb-16m8.description: Parent epic for shipper.rs structured_output fix

lb-1brq.title: Fix Epic CLI args not distinguishing explicit vs default values
lb-1brq.description: Epic command uses default_value_t for timeout/max_failures then checks if value \!= default to decide whether to use config. This means passing --timeout 15 explicitly is treated as 'use config'. Fix by using Option<u32> instead.

lb-1csb.title: DockerError used as tuple struct in ensure_volume — compile error
lb-1csb.description: docker.rs ensure_volume creates DockerError(format!(...)) but DockerError is an enum. Should use a proper variant. Added in e2ddecb.

lb-1ebq.title: Shipper should not create a new branch after merging
lb-1ebq.description: After merging a feature branch into the parent, the shipper unconditionally generates and creates a new feature branch (shipper.rs lines 36-37). This wastes a cycle: the decider must run again just to say 'stop' on an empty branch. The loop already handles branch creation at the top (loop_cmd.rs lines 162-171), so the shipper should just merge and return to main. Remove branch creation from shipper::execute() and update ShipResult accordingly.

lb-1hfx.title: Reorder loop body: decider before runner
lb-1hfx.description: In loop_cmd.rs, move the decider to run first each iteration, then runner, then reviewer. Summary can run in parallel after reviewer. Use loop_logger for the decider since the runner's logger doesn't exist yet.

lb-1jfl.title: Suppress expected litebrite command errors
lb-1jfl.description: lb init logs 'already initialized' and lb sync logs 'no remote configured' on every iteration. Fix: skip lb init when .litebrite/ exists, skip lb sync when no git remote configured (add has_git_remote helper).

lb-1x2u.title: Include stderr in shipper merge failure message
lb-1x2u.description: shipper.rs line 187: gh pr merge failure message says 'gh pr merge failed' but doesn't include stderr, making debugging hard.

lb-1yo3.title: Let runner create follow-up tasks discovered during implementation
lb-1yo3.description: Runner prompt now says 'task graph is managed by the decider' and prohibits creating tasks. But the runner is the agent closest to the code — it discovers bugs, missing pieces, and follow-up work during implementation. Allow the runner to create tasks for discovered work (but not initial decomposition). Something like: 'If you discover follow-up work during implementation, create a task for it. Do not decompose the spec or plan ahead — that is the decider's job.'

lb-1zh1.title: Add --model flag to loop and epic subcommands
lb-1zh1.description: The run command has --model to override the configured model, but loop and epic don't expose this flag.

lb-2095.title: mrmouth summary starts TUI but routes output to raw stderr, hiding all output
lb-2095.description: When 'mrmouth summary' is run on a TTY, TuiHandle::try_start() enters alternate screen mode on stderr. However, summary::execute is called with logger=None (main.rs), so run_streaming_claude uses StreamTarget::Stderr and all formatted output goes via eprintln\! to raw stderr. In alternate screen mode this output is hidden/overwritten by TUI redraws, making summary output invisible. Fix: either (a) pass tui.as_ref() into summary::execute and add TUI routing there, or (b) skip TUI startup for the summary subcommand (add it to the use_raw check).

lb-21dd.title: Fix TUI terminal corruption
lb-21dd.description: Stop bypassing ratatui's rendering pipeline. Subprocesses and eprintln write directly to terminal while ratatui owns it in raw mode, causing staircase text, static elements scrolling away, and content not clearing.

lb-2dra.title: Create src/tui.rs: TuiHandle, TuiSender, multi-pane render thread
lb-2dra.description:
New file src/tui.rs implementing:

Public API:
  pub struct TuiHandle  // owns background render thread; Drop → shutdown
  pub struct TuiSender { label: String, tx: Sender<TuiMsg> }

  impl TuiHandle {
      pub fn try_start() -> Option<Self>   // None if stderr is not TTY
      pub fn sender(&self, label: &str) -> TuiSender
  }
  impl Drop for TuiHandle { fn drop(&mut self) { /* send Quit, join thread */ } }

  impl TuiSender {
      pub fn send_line(&self, line: String)
      pub fn with_label(&self, label: &str) -> Self  // clone with different pane label
  }

Internal:
  enum TuiMsg { Line { pane: String, text: String }, Quit }
  struct TuiState { panes: IndexMap<String, VecDeque<String>>, active: String, max_lines: usize /* 500 */ }

Layout:
  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ mrmouth │ AGENT SESSION │ branch=feat-foo  │  ← header: active pane label
  ├───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ [text]                                    │
  │     I'll start by reading...              │  ← scrolling ring buffer
  │ [Bash]                                    │
  │     lb list                               │
  │ [1/3]  Tab=next  q=quit                  │  ← footer (only if >1 pane)
  └───────────────────────────────────────────┘

Render thread: crossterm alternate screen mode. Loop: recv() on mpsc::Receiver<TuiMsg> + crossterm::event::poll(50ms) for keyboard. Redraws on each event.

Keyboard: Tab cycles panes, q/Ctrl-C sends SIGTERM or process::exit(0) after terminal restore.

ANSI: use ansi-to-tui crate to convert ANSI strings from stream_fmt.rs to ratatui Text/Lines/Spans.

Shutdown: Drop sends Quit, joins thread. Cleanup: disable_raw_mode() + LeaveAlternateScreen.

lb-2hes.title: Epic abort message shows max_failures instead of consecutive_failures
lb-2hes.description: epic.rs:126 prints opts.max_failures in error message but should print consecutive_failures (the actual count). loop_cmd.rs does this correctly.

lb-2rj3.title: Reorder loop: Decider → Runner → Reviewer
lb-2rj3.description: Move decider to run first in the loop so it's the sole authority on whether work exists. Decider checks brites, compares implementation to spec, creates tasks if needed, stops when spec is met. Runner stripped of task-creation. Fixes runaway gold-plating observed in snowflake test.

lb-2x28.title: Fix misleading bootstrap comment in loop_cmd.rs
lb-2x28.description: Line 29 comment says 'run in local (bind-mount) mode' but the code actually uses local: false for all runs including bootstrap. The comment should be updated to match the actual behavior (file-remote fallback).

lb-2y2b.title: Extract shared run harness from loop and epic
lb-2y2b.description: Both loop_cmd.rs and epic.rs duplicate emit(), git_current_branch(), TUI sender setup, and logger creation. Extract a shared run harness module that both modes compose from.

lb-30xw.title: Fix misleading git pull error message in run.rs
lb-30xw.description: In run.rs the git pull --ff-only error handler logs 'No new commits to pull' when stderr is empty and exit code is non-zero. An empty stderr with a failed exit code is a real failure, not 'no new commits'. Should report actual failure.

lb-34j5.title: Fix runner script missing lb sync after init
lb-34j5.description: The runner entrypoint script in run.rs initializes litebrite (lb init, lb setup claude) but never calls lb sync to pull the latest task state. The agent starts with stale state. Add lb sync after lb setup claude in the runner script.

lb-3hsl.title: Add --rm flag to docker run for automatic container cleanup
lb-3hsl.description: The docker run command in docker.rs doesn't use --rm. While there's manual cleanup via remove_container(), adding --rm would provide automatic cleanup if the host process crashes or is killed before cleanup runs.

lb-3jju.title: TUI text_lines slice can panic on out-of-bounds index
lb-3jju.description: In tui.rs around line 296, text_lines[start..end] can panic if indices are invalid. Use safe indexing like .get(start..end).unwrap_or_default() instead.

lb-3m77.title: Decider: check Dockerfile against spec and install tooling on first decomposition
lb-3m77.description: When the decider creates tasks from a fresh spec (step 3, no open items), it should also read .mrmouth/Dockerfile and check whether the required toolchain is installed. If the spec says 'Written in Rust' and the Dockerfile has no Rust, add it. This saves the runner from burning tool calls discovering missing tools and writing code blind without a compiler. The decider already has Edit/Write permissions and the prompt says it MAY edit the Dockerfile — it just needs an instruction to do so during initial decomposition.

lb-3rmy.title: Logger mutex poisoning: recover instead of silently dropping writes
lb-3rmy.description: Logger's write_file uses if let Ok(mut w) = self.writer.lock() which silently drops all writes if the mutex becomes poisoned. Use unwrap_or_else to recover from poisoned locks.

lb-3wn1.title: Git branch fallback silently defaults to main
lb-3wn1.description: run.rs and loop_cmd.rs silently fall back to main if git branch detection fails. Should warn.

lb-3xkv.title: Thread join failures silently ignored in docker.rs and streaming.rs
lb-3xkv.description: Thread join results are silently discarded with let _ = handle.join(). Panics in stderr buffering threads go unnoticed. Should log thread panic info.

lb-472j.title: Add failure circuit-breaker to loop mode
lb-472j.description: Loop has no consecutive failure detection — a broken environment can burn through runs forever. The decider can say stop but that's a completeness judgment, not a safety mechanism. Add max_failures tracking like epic has.

lb-48av.title: Deduplicate git_current_branch in run.rs
lb-48av.description: run.rs has its own git_current_branch that duplicates harness::git_current_branch. Use the harness version and map the error.

lb-4bi1.title: epic max_failures=0 aborts on first failure instead of never aborting
lb-4bi1.description: In epic.rs line 124, the circuit-breaker check is missing the 'opts.max_failures > 0 &&' guard that loop_cmd.rs has correctly. When max_failures=0 (meaning never abort per spec), consecutive_failures (u32) starts at 1 after a failure, and 1 >= 0 is always true, so epic mode aborts on the very first failure. Fix: change the check to: if opts.max_failures > 0 && consecutive_failures >= opts.max_failures {

lb-4c8v.title: Extract updated Dockerfile from container after exit
lb-4c8v.description: SPEC.md says: After the container exits, mrmouth extracts the updated Dockerfile back to .mrmouth/Dockerfile so changes persist. This is not implemented. Need to add docker cp to extract Dockerfile after container exit in run.rs.

lb-4f7m.title: Add per-run timeout to loop mode
lb-4f7m.description: Loop passes timeout: None to run::execute, meaning a hung run blocks the entire pipeline with no recovery. Add a configurable per-run timeout like epic has.

lb-4nvs.title: loop_cmd.rs uses raw eprintln bypassing TUI routing
lb-4nvs.description: Same issue as lb-pmal but in src/loop_cmd.rs: ~12 direct eprintln! calls for bootstrap messages, loop status, and delay notifications bypass the TUI when it is active. Should route through a TuiSender like epic.rs now does.

lb-5amv.title: Fix stream_fmt result text not indented
lb-5amv.description: In stream_fmt.rs, tool result text uses collapsed directly without indent(), while error results use indent(&collapsed). This makes result output misaligned.

lb-5e79.title: Guard Dockerfile extraction against DEFAULT_DOCKERFILE fallback
lb-5e79.description: run.rs unconditionally extracts the container Dockerfile to .mrmouth/Dockerfile after each run. When run 1 used DEFAULT_DOCKERFILE (no user Dockerfile existed), the agent's incompatible Dockerfile overwrites the fallback path, breaking all subsequent Docker builds. Fix: record whether .mrmouth/Dockerfile existed before the run; only extract if it did.

lb-5yis.title: Modify src/summary.rs: switch to stream-json, use streaming helper
lb-5yis.description:
Currently summary uses no --output-format flag (defaults to plain text stdout). The summary text appears but the agent's tool calls (Read, Write) are invisible.

Changes:
1. Add --output-format stream-json to the claude CLI args.
2. Also add --allowedTools to include Read,Write (already there).
3. Replace manual stdout/stderr tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
4. The summary text still gets written to the summary file (agent does this via Write tool).
5. Remove existing tee_stdout and tee_stderr calls.

Result: SUMMARY pane shows agent reading the JSONL log, writing the summary, and final output — all formatted with colors just like the main agent session.

lb-60qe.title: Sub-agent formatter hardcodes is_tty=true, pollutes non-TTY output with ANSI codes
lb-60qe.description: In streaming.rs callers (reviewer.rs, shipper.rs, summary.rs, loop_cmd.rs), StreamFormatter::new(true) is always called regardless of whether stderr is a TTY. This means ANSI escape codes are embedded in output even in non-TTY environments (CI, piped logs). The main agent formatter in run.rs correctly checks stdout.is_terminal(). The fix: in run_streaming_claude or its callers, use io::stderr().is_terminal() || logger.has_tui() to decide is_tty.

lb-68yw.title: Modify src/epic.rs: thread TUI into run::execute calls
lb-68yw.description: Add tui: Option<&TuiHandle> parameter to epic::execute(). Forward to each run::execute() call within the epic loop. No other changes needed — the TUI pane label 'AGENT SESSION' will be reused across iterations (each iteration overwrites the previous content in the same pane, or could append — either is acceptable for v1).

lb-6fha.title: Fix relative path construction in loop_cmd.rs log_file
lb-6fha.description: Not a bug: summary::execute joins relative paths to repo_root. The format! path works correctly.

lb-6scn.title: Compose ready.rs prompt with full default prompt to restore Dockerfile editing
lb-6scn.description: execute() in ready.rs uses prompt_override with a minimal hardcoded prompt that strips the Docker Environment section. Change it to prepend a scope constraint onto the full default prompt (via prompt::load_prompt) so runners know they can edit .mrmouth/Dockerfile.

lb-6xo6.title: loop_cmd.rs decider thread join uses .expect() instead of error handling
lb-6xo6.description: In loop_cmd.rs:191, decider_handle.join().expect('decider thread panicked') will panic if the decider thread panics. Should use proper error handling (match on join result) to log the error and return a graceful failure instead of crashing.

lb-731u.title: Rename epic.rs to do_cmd.rs and update types
lb-731u.description: Rename src/epic.rs to src/do_cmd.rs (do is a Rust keyword). Rename EpicOptions→DoOptions (epic_id→item_id), EpicError→DoError (EpicNotFound→ItemNotFound). In main.rs: mod epic→mod do_cmd, Commands::Epic→Commands::Do (epic_id→item_id), dispatch to do_cmd::execute(). In config.rs: EpicConfig→DoConfig with #[serde(rename="epic")] for TOML backward compat, Config field epic→do_config with same serde rename. Update all tests referencing these types. Preserve all existing slug tests.

lb-7s17.title: Add .dockerignore to reduce Docker build context
lb-7s17.description: Docker build sends entire repo as context including logs/ and .git/. Create default .dockerignore to speed up builds.

lb-8raq.title: Include stderr in DockerError::BuildFailed
lb-8raq.description: BuildFailed(i32) only carries the exit code, discarding stderr. Change to BuildFailed(i32, String) and include the docker build stderr so failures are diagnosable. Update Display impl to show stderr when non-empty.

lb-8t7x.title: Add --branch flag to mrmouth run CLI
lb-8t7x.description: Config supports branch field but there's no CLI flag to override it per-run. Add --branch to run subcommand.

lb-8zzu.title: Fix local mode calling git_remote_url in violation of spec
lb-8zzu.description: run.rs line 57-58 calls git_remote_url() when --local is set. SPEC.md line 188 says: 'run.rs must not call git_remote_url() when --local is set — there may be no remote.' Should use empty string directly instead.

lb-95np.title: Add ready command
lb-95np.description: New file src/ready.rs. ReadyOptions { timeout, max_failures, model }. ReadyError { Command(String), TooManyFailures(u32) }. execute(): (1) create feature branch ready-{YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS}, (2) loop: run lb ready and parse first item ID (break if none), capture HEAD before, build task-focused prompt, run::execute() with prompt_override, capture HEAD after, if new commits run reviewer::execute() with commit_range, sync_and_push(), track consecutive failures and abort if >= max_failures, (3) final sync. Add lb_ready() helper that runs lb ready and parses the first item ID. In main.rs: add Commands::Ready with --timeout --max-failures --model flags, add mod ready, dispatch to ready::execute(). Import shared helpers from do_cmd (sync_and_push, git_current_branch, git_checkout_new_branch).

lb-95nz.title: Fix loop decider allowed tools to include lb commands
lb-95nz.description: The decider prompt says to check litebrite state but only allows Read and Bash(git *). Needs Bash(lb *) too.

lb-9bjb.title: Make ship decision reachable in decider prompt
lb-9bjb.description: The decider instruction algorithm has no path to 'ship'. Steps lead to continue or stop only. Either add an explicit condition for ship (e.g. current branch has N+ commits and remaining work exists) or remove ship from the decider's action enum and the loop body handling if it's intentionally deprecated.

lb-9bod.title: Decider thread panic payload is swallowed
lb-9bod.description: loop_cmd.rs catches decider thread panics but ignores the panic payload, making debugging impossible.

lb-9lnz.title: Modify src/logger.rs: add TUI routing

lb-9x4r.title: Add timeout to reviewer and shipper containers
lb-9x4r.description: reviewer.rs and shipper.rs create ContainerArgs with timeout_secs: None. A hung container could block the loop indefinitely. Add a reasonable default timeout (e.g. 10 min reviewer, 5 min shipper readiness).

lb-9xsm.title: UTF-8 unsafe string slicing in epic.rs branch name truncation
lb-9xsm.description: epic.rs:262 uses byte-based slicing trimmed[..50] which will panic if the 50th byte falls in the middle of a multibyte UTF-8 character. Should use char-based truncation instead.

lb-ad2f.title: SPEC.md epic section missing reviewer step documentation
lb-ad2f.description: The epic subcommand now runs a reviewer agent after each successful task run (matching loop behavior), but SPEC.md step 2 under 'mrmouth epic' only says 'Run agent sessions focused on the epic, one task at a time' — it does not mention the reviewer step. The loop spec explicitly documents this at step 2. The epic spec should be updated to describe the post-run reviewer behavior (analogous to the loop spec step 2).

lb-anmx.title: Create src/shipper.rs
lb-anmx.description: New host-side agent. ShipperOptions { model, current_branch, parent_branch }. ShipResult { new_branch }. Steps: (1) run_shipper_agent checks lb list -s open and runs tests, returns READY/BLOCKED via JSON; (2) merge_branch: file-remote=git merge --no-ff, github=gh pr create + gh pr merge; (3) generate_branch_name asks claude to read SPEC.md for 2-4 word kebab name, formats as feat-{slug}, fallback feat-{timestamp}; (4) create_and_push_branch: git checkout -b, push -u origin if github remote. Also exports create_and_push_branch and generate_branch_name as pub for use by loop_cmd.

lb-aysm.title: docker ensure_volume silently ignores all errors
lb-aysm.description: docker.rs ensure_volume() uses let _ = for volume create and ownership fix. Should propagate errors or at least warn.

lb-btw1.title: Compose do_cmd prompts with full default prompt to restore Dockerfile editing
lb-btw1.description: execute_task() and execute_epic() in do_cmd.rs use prompt_override with minimal hardcoded prompts that strip the Docker Environment section. Change them to prepend a scope constraint onto the full default prompt (via prompt::load_prompt) so runners know they can edit .mrmouth/Dockerfile to install missing tools.

lb-c4kp.title: Reviewer ignores container crash - always returns Ok
lb-c4kp.description: reviewer.rs returns Ok(()) even when container exits non-zero. A reviewer crash is silently ignored.

lb-cmnc.title: Add Ratatui TUI with streaming output to mrmouth
lb-cmnc.description: Add a Ratatui TUI that shows streaming agent output in named panes (one per stage), with a header indicating the active stage and Tab-based pane switching for concurrent stages. Replace all terminal output with TUI-routed versions when running in a TTY. Also fix reviewer, summary, decider, and shipper to use --output-format stream-json so their work is visible (not just stderr chatter).

lb-cqhc.title: Modify src/reviewer.rs: switch to stream-json, use streaming helper
lb-cqhc.description:
Currently reviewer uses --output-format json; its thinking/tool calls/text are invisible (only stderr chatter shown).

Changes:
1. Add --output-format stream-json to the claude CLI args (remove --output-format json if present; reviewer didn't have it explicitly, verify).
2. Replace the manual stdout/stderr tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
3. The reviewer doesn't need structured output — just success/failure — so ignore the returned result string.
4. Remove the existing tee_stdout call (no longer needed).

Result: users see the reviewer's thinking, what it reads (git diff, git log), what lb commands it runs, and its final assessment — all in the CODE REVIEW pane.

lb-dbfv.title: Dedicated log files and jsonl for decider, reviewer, and shipper
lb-dbfv.description:
Runner gets per-run .log + .jsonl with full stream events (thinking, tool calls, results). Decider, reviewer, and shipper all dump formatted text into shared loop.log with no jsonl. Each agent needs its own timestamped log file and raw jsonl capture, same as the runner gets. Specifically:
- Decider: decider-<timestamp>.log + decider-<timestamp>.jsonl (captures should_continue output in streaming.rs)
- Reviewer: review-<timestamp>.log + review-<timestamp>.jsonl (captures reviewer container output in reviewer.rs)
- Shipper: ship-<timestamp>.log + ship-<timestamp>.jsonl (captures shipper container/streaming output)
The jsonl is critical — without it we can't see thinking blocks, tool calls, or structured responses. Also fix the schema description which still says 'start new one' for ship — should match the prompt.

lb-dl1f.title: Replace tab characters in stream_fmt.rs format strings
lb-dl1f.description: The indent() function was fixed to use spaces but inline format strings still use literal tab chars that ratatui cannot expand. Replace \t with two spaces in: line 125 (system init model=), line 175 (Grep pattern), line 184 (Glob pattern), line 206 (generic tool input), line 329 (done turns/cost).

lb-dvhr.title: Code quality and bug fixes
lb-dvhr.description: Address code quality issues: duplicated code, hidden errors, and minor bugs

lb-ebpt.title: Symlink update in run.rs is non-atomic
lb-ebpt.description: In run.rs, latest.jsonl symlink is removed then recreated. If process crashes between the two operations, the symlink is broken. Use a temp symlink + rename for atomicity.

lb-eivs.title: Modify src/loop_cmd.rs: thread TUI, per-stage labels for concurrent stages

lb-eryu.title: Decider JSON parse failures silently default to continue
lb-eryu.description: In loop_cmd.rs, if Claude returns malformed JSON, serde_json::from_str falls back to default Value which causes the decider to default to continue. Should log a warning when JSON parsing fails.

lb-eu3o.title: Fix summary agent file-writing failures on host
lb-eu3o.description: Summary agent prompt asks Claude to Write a file, but host-side Claude Code blocks new file creation. Fix: remove Write from allowed tools, change prompt to stdout-only output, capture the already-available result text from streaming, write summary file from Rust code.

lb-fhpl.title: Fix trailing blank line in TuiSender impl block
lb-fhpl.description: tui.rs line 175 has a blank line before the closing brace of impl TuiSender. Would fail cargo fmt check.

lb-fki2.title: Loop delay sleep ignores TUI cancellation
lb-fki2.description: In loop_cmd.rs, the delay between runs uses thread::sleep which blocks for the full duration. If user presses q/Ctrl+C during the delay, they must wait. Should check cancelled flag in small increments like the watchdog does.

lb-fn11.title: Dynamic TUI header: project name, run number, and stage
lb-fn11.description: Header currently hardcodes 'mrmouth | AGENT SESSION'. Change to show project name (from repo dir), loop run number, and current stage (Agent, Reviewer, Summary, Decider, Shipper). E.g. 'snowflake | Run 3 | Agent'. Requires: TuiState gets project/status fields, TuiMsg::SetStatus variant, TuiHandle::try_start takes project name, TuiHandle::set_status method, header render uses new fields. Callers (main.rs, loop_cmd.rs, run.rs, epic.rs) updated to pass project name and set status at stage transitions.

lb-g45o.title: Epic TooManyFailures error reports max_failures instead of consecutive_failures
lb-g45o.description: epic.rs line 130 passes opts.max_failures to TooManyFailures error instead of consecutive_failures. The error message says 'aborted after N consecutive failures' but N is the configured limit, not the actual count.

lb-g6rz.title: Misleading git pull failure message in run.rs
lb-g6rz.description: run.rs treats all git pull failures (network error, merge conflict, etc.) as 'No new commits to pull'. Should differentiate error cases.

lb-ged3.title: Pass commit range to reviewer so it only reviews new code
lb-ged3.description: The loop already tracks head_before and head_after around each runner execution. Pass these to the reviewer prompt so it runs 'git diff <before>..<after>' instead of reviewing the entire branch. Currently the reviewer re-reads all code every iteration, which wastes context and causes it to re-file issues on old code. The reviewer prompt should say 'review the changes between <before> and <after>' and use that diff as its scope.

lb-gipm.title: Fix --raw mode output goes to stderr instead of stdout
lb-gipm.description: In run.rs raw mode, logger.display(line) routes to eprintln (stderr) in non-TUI mode. Previously this was println (stdout). Raw mode is intended for piping (e.g. mrmouth run --raw | jq), so output must reach stdout. The Logger::display docstring even says 'TUI or stdout' but display_line uses eprintln for the non-TUI case. Fix: add a stdout-routing variant to Logger and use it in the raw branch, or bypass Logger and write directly to stdout in the raw path.

lb-glnx.title: StreamFormatter created with is_tty=false for TUI targets in streaming.rs
lb-glnx.description: In src/streaming.rs, run_streaming_claude callers create StreamFormatter::new(logger.map_or(true, |l| !l.has_tui())). When TUI is active (has_tui()=true), this evaluates to is_tty=false, stripping all ANSI color codes. But the TUI uses ansi_to_tui to render ANSI-coded text, so it CAN display colors. The result is that reviewer, decider, shipper, and summary sub-agent output shows in the TUI without any colors. The flag should be true when the target is a TUI pane.

lb-gwz2.title: Replace is_ok()+unwrap() anti-pattern for commit comparison
lb-gwz2.description: epic.rs:103-105 and loop_cmd.rs:178-180 use is_ok() guard then unwrap(). Should use if-let or ok()+zip() instead.

lb-h5wx.title: Add branch field to RunOptions
lb-h5wx.description: src/run.rs: add 'pub branch: Option<String>' to RunOptions. Update branch resolution to check opts.branch first, then config.branch, then git current branch, then main. Add branch: None to callers in main.rs and epic.rs.

lb-hwg3.title: Reviewer, Shipper, and Branch-per-Feature
lb-hwg3.description: Add reviewer and shipper agents to mrmouth loop, plus branch-per-feature management. Workers always work on a feature branch; reviewer runs after each worker pass; decider gains ship action; shipper handles merging and creates next branch.

lb-imrg.title: Atomic symlink can leave dangling tmp file on rename failure
lb-imrg.description: run.rs atomic_symlink function doesn't clean up the tmp symlink if fs::rename fails.

lb-j6dm.title: Dockerfile extraction failure is silent
lb-j6dm.description: run.rs silently ignores docker cp failure when extracting Dockerfile. Agent modifications to Dockerfile are lost without notification.

lb-jf0a.title: run.rs StreamFormatter strips colors when TUI active but stdout redirected
lb-jf0a.description: In run.rs:149, StreamFormatter is initialized with is_tty = std::io::stdout().is_terminal(). When TUI is active (stderr is a TTY) but stdout is redirected (e.g. mrmouth run > file.txt), is_tty is false and ANSI colors are stripped even though the TUI pane supports them via ansi-to-tui. All other callers in streaming.rs correctly use target.supports_color() which returns true for StreamTarget::Tui. Only run.rs bypasses this. Fix: change run.rs:137 to: let is_tty = logger.has_tui() || std::io::stdout().is_terminal();

lb-jj12.title: process::exit in main.rs bypasses TuiHandle drop, leaving terminal in bad state
lb-jj12.description: In main.rs, the error handlers for run (line 144), loop (line 156), and epic (line 168) call std::process::exit(1) after TUI has already started. process::exit does not run destructors, so TuiHandle::drop is never called. The TUI render thread is not sent Quit, disable_raw_mode and LeaveAlternateScreen are never called, and the terminal is left in raw mode on the alternate screen. Fix: explicitly drop(tui) before calling process::exit(1), or restructure main to avoid process::exit by returning from a run() helper function.

lb-jma3.title: Remove dead code: run_stream_formatter and pub mod stream_fmt
lb-jma3.description: run_stream_formatter in stream_fmt.rs reads stdin/writes stdout but is never called. The pub visibility on mod stream_fmt in main.rs is also unnecessary - only crate-internal modules use it.

lb-jqg3.title: use-after-move in docker.rs ensure_volume chown_status — compile error
lb-jqg3.description: In src/docker.rs ensure_volume(), the pattern 'if let Err(e) = chown_status { ... } else if let Ok(s) = chown_status { ... }' is a use-after-move compile error. chown_status is moved into the first if let expression; accessing it again in the else if let branch is invalid. Fix: use a match expression instead: 'match chown_status { Err(e) => eprintln\!(...), Ok(s) if \!s.success() => eprintln\!(...), _ => {} }'. File: src/docker.rs lines 152-158. Introduced in commit 0f34a6d.

lb-k3be.title: Suppress subprocess stdio when TUI is active
lb-k3be.description: Every .status() call that doesn't redirect stdout/stderr inherits the parent terminal, bypassing ratatui. Change to .output() or add Stdio::null()/Stdio::piped(). Files: docker.rs build() change .status()->.output() and route stderr through logger. epic.rs git push/checkout: capture or null. loop_cmd.rs git init/add/commit: capture or null. shipper.rs gh pr merge, git checkout/pull/merge/branch/push: capture or null. run.rs git diff/config: add Stdio::null().

lb-kl4s.title: Add individual task support to do command
lb-kl4s.description: In do_cmd.rs, add ItemInfo { title, item_type } struct. Enhance lb_show() to parse the Type: line from lb show output, returning ItemInfo instead of just a String. Add type-based dispatch in execute(): if item_type is 'task' (or no children found), run a single agent session with a task-focused prompt ('Work on task {id}. lb show, claim, implement, commit, close, lb sync, git push.'), then run reviewer on the diff. If item_type is 'epic', use the existing children loop. Extract shared helpers as pub(crate): sync_and_push(), git_current_branch(), git_checkout_new_branch(), make_slug().

lb-kwd4.title: Deduplicate git_remote_url function
lb-kwd4.description: git_remote_url is copy-pasted identically in run.rs, reviewer.rs, and shipper.rs. Move to harness.rs.

lb-kwof.title: Add cargo fmt check to CI workflow
lb-kwof.description: CI runs clippy and tests but doesn't check formatting. Add cargo fmt -- --check step.

lb-l5j3.title: Rename epic to do, add ready command, restrict lb create to reviewer
lb-l5j3.description: The mrmouth epic command only works with epics. Rename it to 'do' so it handles both epics and individual tasks. Add a new 'ready' command that picks up whatever lb ready items are available. Both are simple runner+reviewer loops (no decider, no shipper). Remove lb create from the runner prompt so only the reviewer can add brites.

lb-l78i.title: Update loop_cmd: Decision enum, decider schema, branch management
lb-l78i.description: Decision enum: add Ship variant. Decider JSON schema: change from {continue:bool} to {action: continue|ship|stop, reason}. Update should_continue to parse action field. execute(): capture parent_branch before feature branch creation; bootstrap mode stays on main (no branch created); otherwise call shipper::generate_branch_name + create_and_push_branch; track current_branch as mutable; pass branch: Some(current_branch) to RunOptions; run reviewer after litebrite::sync (serial, before decider); handle Ship decision by calling shipper::execute and updating current_branch. Add BranchCreation variant to LoopError. Add git_current_branch helper.

lb-l836.title: Add --model flag to mrmouth summary CLI
lb-l836.description: The summary subcommand always uses loop_config.summary_model with no CLI override. Add --model flag.

lb-ljfl.title: Add --init flag to docker run to reap zombie processes
lb-ljfl.description: Docker containers without --init don't have a proper init process (PID 1). If the agent spawns background processes that die, they become zombies. The --init flag adds tini as PID 1 to properly reap them.

lb-m12l.title: Register modules in main.rs
lb-m12l.description: Add 'mod reviewer;' and 'mod shipper;' to main.rs. Add branch: None to RunOptions construction in Commands::Run arm.

lb-mgza.title: Docker build stderr swallowed on failure
lb-mgza.description: docker build -q suppresses all output. When a build fails, the user only sees 'docker build failed (exit code N)' with no indication of what went wrong. Capture stderr and include it in the error message on failure.

lb-mke6.title: Fix loop bugs found in snowflake test
lb-mke6.description: Running mrmouth loop on a fresh project revealed 3 bugs: Dockerfile extraction breaks subsequent runs, summary agent can't write files on host, and litebrite commands produce log noise.

lb-mkeq.title: mrmouth epic should work with standalone tasks, not just epic children
lb-mkeq.description:
Currently 'mrmouth epic <id>' only finds child tasks of the given epic. If you pass a standalone task (not an epic, or an epic with no children), it reports 'All tasks complete' and exits without doing anything.

Expected behavior: 'mrmouth epic <task-id>' should work on any item — if it's a standalone task, treat it as a single-item workload. If it's an epic with children, work the children. The current behavior forces users to wrap standalone tasks in a parent epic as a workaround, which is unnecessary ceremony.

Discovered when trying to run 'mrmouth epic lb-nu6d' on a standalone task — it did nothing until the task was reparented under a new epic.

lb-mxo4.title: Loop continues post-run AI stages after TUI cancellation
lb-mxo4.description: When the user presses q/Ctrl+C in the TUI, the cancellation flag is set and the watcher thread stops the Docker container. However, loop_cmd.rs only checks is_cancelled() at the top of each loop iteration and before sleeping — not immediately after run::execute returns. This means after a user-requested cancel, the loop still runs litebrite::sync, the reviewer (if commits exist), and spawns summary+decider threads before checking cancellation again. Fix: add a cancellation check in loop_cmd::execute immediately after run::execute returns, before litebrite::sync and the post-run AI stages.

lb-n90u.title: Loop --delay 0 cannot override non-zero config default
lb-n90u.description: main.rs:155 uses 'if delay > 0' to decide CLI vs config value, making it impossible to explicitly set --delay 0. Should use Option<u32> like other flags.

lb-nu6d.title: Readiness checker in shipper.rs fails to parse structured_output from Claude CLI
lb-nu6d.description:
The readiness check in shipper.rs uses --json-schema to get a structured READY/BLOCKED response from Claude CLI. It fails with 'readiness check returned invalid JSON: EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 0'.

Root cause: same bug that was just fixed in streaming.rs for the decider. When Claude CLI is invoked with --json-schema, the JSONL result event puts the structured JSON in a 'structured_output' field, not 'result'. The 'result' field is an empty string.

The streaming.rs fix (commit from tonight) correctly handles this for the decider path. But the shipper.rs readiness checker does its own result parsing — it doesn't go through the streaming code path. It needs the same fix: check for structured_output first, serialize the object to a string, fall back to result for non-schema calls.

The readiness checker runs inside a Docker container and captures stdout. Look at how it parses the claude CLI output and apply the same structured_output handling that was applied to streaming.rs.

Reproduction: run mrmouth loop on any project with completed work. The decider will correctly say 'ship', but shipping will fail with the JSON parse error on the readiness check.

Files: src/shipper.rs (primary), src/streaming.rs (reference for the fix pattern)

lb-nwd4.title: Update README.md config defaults and missing loop flags
lb-nwd4.description: README config section shows wrong volume default (mrmouth-claude-home vs per-project), shows branch=main but default is current branch (None). Loop section in README is missing --max-failures and --timeout flags. Loop config missing reviewer_timeout and shipper_timeout.

lb-o0x7.title: mrmouth summary standalone command now outputs to stderr instead of stdout (spec deviation)
lb-o0x7.description: SPEC.md says: 'Print summary to stdout'. Before this branch, summary.rs used tee_stdout (println\!) to display Claude output. After this branch, it uses StreamTarget::Stderr -> eprintln\!. Anyone piping 'mrmouth summary > file.md' now gets an empty file. Fix: for the standalone summary command, either use StreamTarget::Stdout (add a new variant) or keep using println\! for the summary command path.

lb-o60w.title: Add reviewer pass to do command
lb-o60w.description: Add reviewer integration to do_cmd.rs. For task path: capture HEAD before/after the single run, call reviewer::execute() with commit_range if commits were made. For epic path: capture HEAD before the children loop starts and after it ends, then run one reviewer pass at the end covering the entire epic's diff (no reviewer per child). Use ReviewerOptions { model: config.loop_config.reviewer_model, current_branch, commit_range }.

lb-oj9p.title: litebrite.rs uses which command — not portable
lb-oj9p.description: has_lb() uses 'which lb' which is not available everywhere. Try running lb directly or use command -v instead.

lb-okra.title: Modify src/run.rs: wire TUI into agent session streaming

lb-ol2g.title: Update SPEC.md with new --branch and --model flags
lb-ol2g.description: SPEC.md is missing documentation for: run --branch flag, summary --model flag

lb-oskn.title: Fix Dockerfile cross-platform support for ARM/aarch64
lb-oskn.description: The DEFAULT_DOCKERFILE hardcodes x86_64-unknown-linux-musl for the litebrite build stage. This fails on ARM machines (Apple Silicon Macs). Should detect architecture dynamically.

lb-pmal.title: epic.rs uses raw eprintln bypassing TUI routing
lb-pmal.description: src/epic.rs has ~12 direct eprintln! calls throughout execute(). When TUI is active, stderr is in alternate screen mode (crossterm EnterAlternateScreen). Raw eprintln to stderr in this mode either corrupts TUI rendering or produces invisible output. epic.rs needs to receive a Logger or TuiHandle and route all its status output through it.

lb-q2aw.title: Route litebrite and prompt errors through logger
lb-q2aw.description: litebrite.rs lines 26/28/32 use eprintln! directly which bypasses TUI. Change run_lb() and init_and_sync()/sync() to accept optional &Logger and route messages through it. Similarly prompt.rs line 46 uses eprintln! for warnings. Callers already have loggers available to pass in.

lb-q88t.title: Add ratatui, crossterm, ansi-to-tui to Cargo.toml
lb-q88t.description:
Add dependencies to Cargo.toml:
  ratatui = "0.29"
  crossterm = "0.28"
  ansi-to-tui = "4"

These are needed for the TUI implementation. ansi-to-tui converts ANSI-colored strings from stream_fmt.rs into ratatui Span structures so colors are preserved in the TUI.

lb-qnpw.title: Rewrite decider prompt and permissions
lb-qnpw.description: Rewrite decider prompt: check lb list for open brites, if any exist return continue. If none, compare implementation to SPEC.md. If deficiencies found, create brites and optionally edit Dockerfile, return continue. If spec satisfied, return stop. Expand permissions to Read,Edit,Write,Bash(git *),Bash(lb *). Remove observer-only admonishment. Keep boundary: do not implement features or claim tasks.

lb-rv1t.title: Update SPEC.md volume default to match per-project behavior
lb-rv1t.description: SPEC says default volume is 'mrmouth-claude-home' but the code generates per-project volumes like 'mrmouth-claude-home-{repo-name}'. SPEC should document the actual behavior.

lb-seph.title: Litebrite operations silently swallow all errors with no logging
lb-seph.description: In litebrite.rs, all lb commands suppress stderr/stdout and ignore failures. While these are best-effort, there should be at least debug-level logging when they fail, to aid in troubleshooting issues where lb state gets out of sync.

lb-si5j.title: Add GitHub Actions release workflow
lb-si5j.description: The spec mentions distributing via GitHub releases with prebuilt binaries for Linux and macOS (x86_64, aarch64). Add a release.yml workflow triggered on tag push that cross-compiles and publishes binaries.

lb-skwk.title: Add reviewer step to epic mode
lb-skwk.description: Epic mode has no review step — it blindly trusts each run's output. Add reviewer invocation, probably at the end of the epic after all tasks complete, to catch bad commits before the branch is merged.

lb-t7nw.title: Decider should close parent epics before shipping
lb-t7nw.description: When the decider determines all child tasks of an epic are closed and the implementation satisfies the spec, it should close the parent epic before returning 'ship'. Currently it leaves the epic open, which causes the shipper readiness check to fail ('Open item exists'), wasting a full decider+runner+reviewer cycle. Fix: add instruction to the decider prompt to close epics whose children are all closed before returning ship.

lb-tipn.title: Add text wrapping to body Paragraph
lb-tipn.description: In tui.rs draw(), add .wrap(Wrap { trim: false }) to the body Paragraph widget. Without this, lines longer than terminal width are silently clipped. Import ratatui::widgets::Wrap.

lb-tso7.title: Create src/reviewer.rs
lb-tso7.description: New host-side claude agent. Mirrors summary.rs pattern. ReviewerOptions { model, current_branch }. Allowed tools: Read,Bash(git diff *),Bash(git log *),Bash(lb *). Prompt: review changes on current_branch vs SPEC.md using git diff/log, create brites for issues (lb create), mark done items (lb close). Single pass. Non-fatal at call site.

lb-tvkb.title: Epic creates feature branch but doesn't push before first container run
lb-tvkb.description: epic.rs creates a new feature branch locally via git checkout -b, but the first run::execute call will clone from remote using that branch name. Since it hasn't been pushed yet, the clone fails. Fix: push the new branch to remote after creating it.

lb-u4qp.title: Cancel watcher thread leaks if run::execute errors after thread spawn
lb-u4qp.description: In run.rs, the cancel watcher thread is spawned before the streaming/wait logic. If stream_output() or handle.wait() returns an error, run::execute returns early via ? without setting watcher_done=true. The _cancel_watcher JoinHandle drops (detaching the thread), leaving it spinning at 200ms intervals indefinitely (until TUI q is pressed or process exits). In a loop with repeated failures, multiple watcher threads accumulate. Fix: set watcher_done=true in a defer-style pattern (e.g. on Drop), or join/signal the thread on all exit paths.

lb-u9z2.title: Extract run_streaming_claude helper for shared streaming logic
lb-u9z2.description:
Create a shared helper (in src/agent.rs or as a private module-level function) for running a claude CLI subprocess with --output-format stream-json and routing output to a Logger/TUI pane.

Signature:
  fn run_streaming_claude(
      child: Child,
      formatter: &mut StreamFormatter,
      logger: Option<&Logger>,
  ) -> Result<String, io::Error>
  // Returns: content of the final 'result' event (for structured output parsing)

Implementation:
  1. Tee child.stderr via logger.tee_stderr()
  2. Read stdout JSONL line by line
  3. For each line: route through stream_fmt::format_line() → logger.display()
  4. Collect lines; find the event where type=="result", return its "result" field value
  5. Wait for child exit, check status

This avoids duplication across reviewer, summary, decider, shipper. The returned result string is parsed as JSON by callers that need structured output (decider, check_ready, generate_branch_name). Callers that don't need structured output (reviewer) ignore the return value.

lb-uaey.title: Modify src/shipper.rs: switch check_ready and generate_branch_name to stream-json
lb-uaey.description:
Currently check_ready and generate_branch_name use --output-format json --json-schema ...; their reasoning is invisible.

Changes in check_ready():
1. Keep --json-schema schema.
2. Change --output-format to stream-json.
3. Replace wait_with_output() + manual tee with run_streaming_claude(child, &mut formatter, logger).
4. Parse status/reason from returned result string:
   let result_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&result_text)?;
   let status = result_json["status"].as_str()...;

Changes in generate_branch_name():
1. Same pattern: stream-json, streaming helper, parse branch name from result string.
2. The fallback (timestamp-based name) stays for error cases.

Note: shipper also uses logger parameter already, so the streaming helper integrates cleanly.

lb-uiox.title: Add reviewer_model and shipper_model to LoopConfig
lb-uiox.description: src/config.rs: add reviewer_model (default sonnet) and shipper_model (default sonnet) to LoopConfig struct and its Default impl. Update full_config_parses test.

lb-un4s.title: git pull after container exit has no timeout
lb-un4s.description: run.rs git pull --ff-only has no timeout. If remote is unreachable, mrmouth hangs indefinitely.

lb-v1qa.title: Epic should pass feature branch to RunOptions explicitly
lb-v1qa.description: epic.rs creates RunOptions with branch: None, relying on run.rs to re-detect the current branch. Should pass the known feature_branch explicitly to avoid redundant detection and potential mismatch.

lb-vfnx.title: Decider: decompose epics into leaf tasks before returning continue
lb-vfnx.description: The decider short-circuits on 'open items exist' without checking whether those items are implementable. If the only open items are epics with no child tasks, the runner has nothing to pick and the loop spins. Fix: after step 1 (lb list), if all open items are epics/non-leaf, the decider should decompose them into tasks before returning continue. Prompt needs to mention epics, --parent, and hierarchical structure.

lb-vjkj.title: Fails on pre-initialized empty repo
lb-vjkj.description: When the target repo has already had 'git init' and 'lb init' run manually before mrmouth starts, mrmouth skips its own init but nobody makes the first commit. It then creates a feature branch (e.g. feat-pty-passthrough) and tries to clone it into Docker, which fails because the branch has zero commits: 'fatal: Remote branch feat-pty-passthrough not found in upstream origin'. The decider loops retrying indefinitely. Fix: detect when the repo has no commits and make a seed commit before creating feature branches.

lb-vsce.title: Modify src/main.rs: start TUI, thread into subcommands
lb-vsce.description:
In main():
1. After config loading, check if stderr is TTY and --raw not set:
   let tui = if !raw { tui::TuiHandle::try_start() } else { None };

2. Thread Option<&TuiHandle> into each subcommand:
   - run::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - loop_cmd::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - epic::execute(&config, &repo_root, opts, tui.as_ref())
   - summary::execute() doesn't need TUI (standalone command)

3. TuiHandle drops at end of main() → clean terminal restore.

The 'raw' flag for mrmouth run disables TUI. Non-TTY contexts (pipes, CI) also disable it via try_start() returning None.

lb-vy69.title: Restore Dockerfile editing capability in do and ready flows
lb-vy69.description: The do and ready flows use prompt_override with minimal hardcoded prompts that strip the Docker Environment section from the default runner prompt. Runners don't know they can edit .mrmouth/Dockerfile to install missing tools. Fix by composing prompts that prepend scope constraints onto the full default prompt.

lb-wi67.title: Update docs for do and ready commands
lb-wi67.description: In README.md: replace the 'mrmouth epic' section with 'mrmouth do <id>' documenting that it works on both epics (loops through children, reviewer at end) and individual tasks (single run + reviewer). Add 'mrmouth ready' section documenting it picks up lb ready items, creates a feature branch, runs runner+reviewer per item. In SPEC.md: same updates to the epic/do section and add ready command spec. Update config.toml examples if they reference [epic].

lb-wil9.title: SPEC.md missing --timeout for loop mode
lb-wil9.description: The --timeout flag was added to loop mode (commit 8d4453e 'Add per-run timeout to loop mode') but SPEC.md only documents --timeout under the epic subcommand (line 73). The loop subcommand flags section (lines 53-58) does not mention --timeout. SPEC.md should be updated to document this flag for loop mode.

lb-x5un.title: Remove lb create from runner prompt
lb-x5un.description: In src/prompt.rs, delete the line: '- If you discover follow-up work during implementation (bugs, missing pieces, edge cases), create a task for it with `lb create`.' The reviewer (reviewer.rs) already has lb create permission. No other files need changes for this.

lb-xfzy.title: TUI q/Ctrl+C exits via process::exit bypassing Docker cleanup
lb-xfzy.description: In src/tui.rs render_loop(), pressing q or Ctrl+C calls std::process::exit(0) after cleanup_terminal(). This bypasses all cleanup in the main thread: running Docker containers are not stopped (orphan containers), litebrite state is not synced, and any other cleanup code (git pulls, etc.) is skipped. Should send a cancellation signal to the main thread instead of calling process::exit.

lb-xkq6.title: Strip task-creation from runner prompt
lb-xkq6.description: In prompt.rs DEFAULT_PROMPT, remove steps 3 and 7 which tell the runner to create tasks. Runner should only pick existing tasks, implement, and commit. Task creation is now the decider's job.

lb-xl9q.title: Container name collision when runs overlap
lb-xl9q.description: Container names use format 'run-{timestamp}' with second-level precision. If two mrmouth instances run from the same repo at the same second, they'll collide on container name. Low probability but could add a random suffix.

lb-xxgz.title: Epic branch push failure should warn instead of silently continuing
lb-xxgz.description: In epic.rs line 48-50, the initial push of the feature branch silently ignores failures. If push fails, the container will try to clone a branch that doesn't exist on the remote. Should log a warning or return an error.

lb-y354.title: Add unit tests for run.rs helper functions
lb-y354.description: run.rs has testable helper functions (preflight checks, git_remote_url, configure_file_remote, git_current_branch, write_runner_script) that lack tests. Add unit tests for these.

lb-ys68.title: Split multi-line strings into individual lines on ingest
lb-ys68.description: In tui.rs push_line(), split incoming text on newlines and store each as a separate VecDeque entry. Currently multi-line strings (thinking blocks, tool results) are stored as single entries making MAX_LINES=500 count logical blocks not display lines, and requiring full re-parse of huge strings through ansi_to_tui on every render frame.

lb-yzzv.title: Modify loop_cmd.rs::should_continue: switch decider to stream-json

lb-zcay.title: Deduplicate runner script boilerplate
lb-zcay.description: The clone/lb-init/.claude.json-restore preamble is duplicated verbatim in run.rs, reviewer.rs, and shipper.rs. Extract a shared function that generates the script boilerplate.
